visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of an animated green frog character wearing a dark navy suit, white dress shirt, and a purple tie. The frog has a sad facial expression with large, glistening eyes and a down-turned mouth. A pink banner with white text is at the top of the frame. (2) A side profile shot of a grey heron character is shown. The heron is dressed in a light grey suit and a blue tie, appearing to be in a calm, professional conversation. The background is a blurred indoor setting with soft lighting. (3) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the frog character sitting at a wooden desk in a dimly lit library or study. He is reading a large red book. To his right is a lit oil lamp on a chest of drawers, and the background is filled with bookshelves and a large arched window showing a night scene. (4) The camera returns to a close-up of the frog's face, maintaining his sad and vulnerable expression. (5) A close-up of the heron character speaking. His facial features are calm, and he gestures slightly with his beak as he communicates. (6) The frog is shown again in close-up, now with visible tears streaming down his face from his large eyes. (7) An extreme close-up focuses on the heron's face, specifically his eye and long orange beak, as he continues to talk. (8) The frog is shown looking downward, still crying, appearing deep in thought and emotional distress. (9) The heron is shown smiling slightly in a close-up shot, conveying a sense of warmth and understanding. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 「不許哭」扼殺一個人？. [Logo]: 維維維. [Subtitle]: 「其實我不喜歡. (2) [Subtitle]: 像剛才那樣『嚎啕大哭』」. (3) [Subtitle]: 「你肯定不喜歡，不過你看. (4) [Subtitle]: 想起不快樂的時光，人自然會悲傷」. (5) [Subtitle]: 「哭，沒有錯」. (6) [Subtitle]: 「但如果你否認情緒，就像把身體的一部份切掉一樣」. (7) [Subtitle]: 「你會成為一個不完整的人」. (8) [Subtitle]: 「可是，我父親從不允許我哭...」. (9) [Subtitle]: 「我一哭，他就會嚴厲的叫我馬上停下來」. (10) [Subtitle]: 「那你要聽從你已經過世的父親的聲音，還是要允許自己真正做主？」. (11) [Subtitle]: 「在心理治療裡，看似小小的問題『要不要哭』」. (12) [Subtitle]: 「往往背後牽動著非常巨大的議題，因為它是線索」. (13) [Subtitle]: 「能帶出『大作』深層的心理模式」. (14) [Slogan]: 溝通分析創始人愛瑞克·伯恩曾說過：. (15) [Slogan]: 每個人生下來都是王子和公主，是父母把他們變成了青蛙。. (16) [Slogan]: People are born princes and princesses until their parents turn them into frogs.. (17) [Slogan]: 「心理治療的目的，就是讓青蛙再變回王子」

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a psychological educational piece presented through animation. It aims to explain the importance of acknowledging and expressing emotions, specifically crying, by illustrating a metaphorical conversation between a suppressed individual (the frog) and a supportive therapist-like figure (the heron). It concludes with a quote about the goal of psychotherapy being the reclamation of one's true self.
